_about: Public-domain Henry Wilkes (1805-1886), Congregational minister of Zion Church, Montreal, and principal of the Congregational College of British North America, for the Word Hoard: Who is Christ? (the 1851 sermon John Cordner answered), Jesus the Divine Messiah, his Zion Church discourses, The Internal Administration of the Churches (1859), a lecture on freedom of mind, a funeral address, and Brief Annals of Zion Church (1871). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 93 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
